storyline.governing_thought: Each text_exhibit slide is judged on what it is trying to be

eval.purpose: Archetype battery (text_exhibit): one argument / three bullets / long paragraph / short narrative / quote-like / Spanish

slides.headline: Only one argument is needed: the contract expires in March

points: The supplier contract expires in March and cannot be extended

slides.headline: We should act before the summer, for three reasons

points: Prices rise 8% in July
Two competitors are already switching
The tender takes four months

slides.headline: The case for change fits in one paragraph

points: Our cost base grew 9% a year for five years while revenue grew 4%, and the gap is now structural: two thirds of the increase comes from overheads that do not scale with volume, from duplicated regional functions, and from IT systems that were never integrated after the last three acquisitions. Without a reset, operating margin falls below 5% by 2027, below the level at which we can fund the investment the strategy requires.

slides.headline: Tres condiciones para que el piloto sea un éxito

points: Un responsable a tiempo completo en cada tienda
Datos de ventas diarios, no semanales
Libertad para ajustar precios sin aprobación central
“I do not mind paying more if it arrives when you say it will.”
“The app is fine; the problem is when something goes wrong.”

slides.headline: Five risks could delay the plan; each has a mitigation

points: Supplier delays: dual-source the two critical components
Union opposition: early consultation and a no-redundancy guarantee for 2026
IT readiness: freeze other projects during the ERP cut-over
Customer churn during migration: dedicated retention team
Cost overrun: 15% contingency released only by the steering committee

slides.headline: La historia en breve: crecimos rápido y ahora toca consolidar

points: En cinco años pasamos de 40 a 160 tiendas, abrimos dos países y lanzamos la venta online. Ese crecimiento dejó una organización con procesos distintos en cada país y márgenes que no han seguido a las ventas.

slides.headline: Our principles for the new pricing policy

points: Prices reflect value to the customer, not cost plus margin
One list price per country, discounts only against volume commitments
Every exception is approved, recorded and reviewed quarterly

slides.headline: Cuatro cambios en la política de viajes reducen el gasto un 18%

points: Reserva obligatoria con 14 días de antelación
Clase turista en vuelos de menos de cinco horas
Tope de 120 € por noche de hotel en ciudades de nivel 2
Aprobación del director para viajes internacionales

slides.headline: What we heard in twelve interviews with store managers

points: Staffing: rosters arrive too late to plan childcare, so people swap shifts informally
Systems: the ordering tool needs three screens for one product and crashes at peak times
Targets: half of the KPIs on the store dashboard are not under the manager's control
Recognition: good months are never mentioned, bad months are escalated within hours
Training: new starters learn on the job from whoever is on shift
Communication: head-office emails arrive after customers have already asked about promotions

slides.headline: Two conditions must hold before we sign

points: Due diligence confirms the €40M of synergies
The regulator clears the deal without remedies

slides.headline: The pilot shows what works in stores

points: Stores with a dedicated lead improved twice as fast
Daily data mattered more than the pricing algorithm
Staff accepted the change once they saw their own results
Roll out with the same three conditions
